metadata.title: Taut and Dupin Submanifolds (Updated Version)
metadata.abstract: This is an updated version of a paper by the author which originally appeared in 1997. The original paper was a survey of the closely related fields of taut and Dupin submanifolds of Euclidean space, and this updated version includes many results in the field that have appeared since the publication of the original version. The emphasis is on stating results in their proper context and noting areas for future research, and relatively few proofs are given. The important class of isoparametric hypersurfaces is surveyed in detail, as is the relationship between the two concepts of taut and Dupin. Also included is a brief introduction to submanifold theory in Lie sphere geometry which is needed to state many known results on Dupin submanifolds accurately. The paper concludes with detailed descriptions of the main known classification results for both Dupin and taut submanifolds.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 更新 taut 与 Dupin 子流形领域的综述，纳入 1997 年以来的成果，系统介绍等参超曲面、Lie 球几何及主要分类结果。
analysis.breakthrough: 提供领域脉络、概念关系与待研究问题的集中入口。
analysis.limitations: 定位为综述，摘要说明仅给少量证明，不应当作单一新分类定理报道。 本次依据官方公告摘要分析，尚未核查正文和完整证明；未见披露仅指当前已读摘要与作者评论。
analysis.priorityReason: 适合补齐背景与组织组会阅读，优先级略低于同日直接解决核心问题的原始研究。
